note: Ring machine registry for the I/1 Fashion held social pieces (RN Collins studio, Nov 2, 2026). One real, openly licensed photo of an old machine per carousel, never reused: no two carousels share a file, a Commons page or a photo hash, and none of these Commons pages is in the studio machine library (library/registry.json, its Oct 11 additions or its rejected list). Ring licences allowed: CC0, CC BY (not share-alike), public domain, U.S. government. CC BY rings are credited as cropped. Pins and the YouTube thumbnail use the carousel A machine; the Reel storyboard uses the carousel B machine (the brand rule that derived assets of one story use that story's machine).
